domain_restrictions: n is positive (so n is not 0)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all positive natural numbers n, for all integers j, and for all real d satisfying 0 <= d < 1/n, the function values K at (n, j, d) and H at (n, j, d) are equal: K_{n,j}(d) equals H_{n,j}(d).
quantifier_order: for all positive natural number n
for all real number d with 0 <= d and d < 1/n

variables.name: n
variables.role: global parameter of the functions and of the upper bound 1/n

witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses; the statement is a direct universal equality constraint

statement_nl: For every positive natural number n, every integer j, and every real d with 0 <= d and d < 1/n, one has K_{n,j}(d) = H_{n,j}(d).
